_comment: Server-to-client traffic that mutates buffers. workspace/applyEdit carries a whole WorkspaceEdit (a server asking us to rewrite files); window/showDocument names a file and a selection to jump to. Both are applied to a buffer, so both must be position-converted and both must survive a malformed shape. Uses the `changes` map form of WorkspaceEdit; the `documentChanges` form is covered by shapes_document_changes.json.
